name: automation
description: 管理自动化定时任务（持久化，跨会话生效，由后台调度器自动执行；每次触发会创建一个真实任务显示在任务列表中）。action="create" 新建任务（需 title、prompt 与 cwd（任务执行的工作目录绝对路径）；scheduleType="cron"（默认）为周期循环，需 5 字段 cron 表达式，如 "0 9 * * *" 表示每天 9 点；scheduleType="once" 为指定时间执行一次，需 runAt 为未来的 ISO 时间，执行后自动标记完成并保留；可选 description/icon/agentId）。action="update" 加 id 与要修改的字段（title/description/icon/prompt/cwd/agentId/enabled/paused/scheduleType/cron/runAt；once 任务修改 runAt 会自动重置完成状态以便重新调度）。action="delete" 加 id 删除任务。action="list" 列出全部任务（含 id/调度/状态/下次执行时间；操作前建议先 list）。action="get" 加 id 查看单个任务详情与最近运行记录。action="trigger" 加 id 立即触发一次执行（异步，不影响原调度计划）。action="pause"/"resume" 加 id 暂停/恢复调度。action="history" 加 id 查看运行历史（含每次运行创建的任务 taskId，可据此查看运行对话）。用户提到"定时任务""自动化""每天几点执行"等需求时应使用本工具。
description_en: Manage automation scheduled tasks (persisted, effective across sessions, executed automatically by the background scheduler; each firing creates a real task shown in the task list). action="create" to create a task (requires title, prompt and cwd (absolute working directory path for the task); scheduleType="cron" (default) is recurring and requires a 5-field cron expression, e.g. "0 9 * * *" for daily at 9:00; scheduleType="once" runs a single time at a future ISO runAt and is marked completed afterwards; optional description/icon/agentId). action="update" with id plus fields to change (title/description/icon/prompt/cwd/agentId/enabled/paused/scheduleType/cron/runAt; changing runAt of a once task resets its completed state for rescheduling). action="delete" with id deletes a task. action="list" lists all tasks (with ids/schedule/status/next run; listing first is recommended). action="get" with id shows one task's details and recent runs. action="trigger" with id runs it immediately (async, without affecting the schedule). action="pause"/"resume" with id toggles scheduling. action="history" with id shows run history (including the taskId of the real task created per run, usable to inspect the conversation). Use this tool whenever the user mentions scheduled/recurring/automated tasks.

id.description: 自动化任务 id。除 create/list 外必填
id.description_en: Automation task id. Required by all actions except create/list

title.description: 任务标题。create 必填；update 可选
title.description_en: Task title. Required for create; optional for update

icon.description: 任务图标，lucide 图标 kebab-case 名称（如 calendar-clock、newspaper、trending-up），可选
icon.description_en: Task icon, a lucide kebab-case icon name (e.g. calendar-clock, newspaper, trending-up), optional

scheduleType.description: 调度类型：cron=周期循环（默认）；once=指定时间执行一次
scheduleType.description_en: Schedule type: cron=recurring (default); once=run once at a specific time

cron.description: 5 字段 cron 表达式（分 时 日 月 周，如 "0 9 * * *" 每天 9 点、"0 10 * * 1" 每周一 10 点）。scheduleType=cron 时必填
cron.description_en: 5-field cron expression (minute hour day month weekday, e.g. "0 9 * * *" daily at 9:00, "0 10 * * 1" Mondays at 10:00). Required when scheduleType=cron

runAt.description: 一次性执行时间，ISO 8601 格式（如 2026-08-23T09:00:00+08:00），必须在未来。scheduleType=once 时必填
runAt.description_en: One-shot execution time in ISO 8601 (e.g. 2026-08-23T09:00:00+08:00), must be in the future. Required when scheduleType=once

prompt.description: 触发时发送给 agent 的执行指令（任务到点后自动执行的内容）。create 必填；update 可选
prompt.description_en: Instruction sent to the agent when the task fires. Required for create; optional for update

cwd.description: 任务执行的工作目录绝对路径（触发时以该目录运行）。create 必填；update 可选
cwd.description_en: Absolute working directory path the task runs in. Required for create; optional for update

agentId.description: 执行用的 agent id（可选，缺省用默认 agent）
agentId.description_en: Agent id to run with (optional; default agent if omitted)

enabled.description: 是否启用。仅 update 使用
enabled.description_en: Whether the task is enabled. Only used by update

paused.description: 是否暂停调度。仅 update 使用
paused.description_en: Whether scheduling is paused. Only used by update
